name: BEF Entity Select Buttons
description: Adds a Better Exposed Filters widget that renders an exposed filter's options as styled buttons, with optional per-bundle 'add entity' links.
project_description: BEF Entity Select Buttons is a small add-on for the Better Exposed Filters (BEF) module. It ships a single BEF filter-widget plugin, 'BEF entity select buttons', that a site builder can pick for a Views exposed filter (from the exposed-filter's BEF settings). Instead of the default select list or plain links, the filter's options are rendered as clickable buttons styled with core's button classes, arranged in a CSS grid or flexbox. When the exposed filter is an entity/bundle filter, the widget can optionally append a small 'add entity' button next to each option that deep-links to that bundle's add-content form (respecting the current user's create-access). It reuses BEF's Links widget and bef-links template wholesale, only changing markup/classes and adding the optional add-content link, so it inherits BEF's URL/query handling. The module adds no routes, permissions, config schema, services beyond one URL helper, or content of its own.
